subject: Archon Systems - purchase authorization, segmented invoicing and pricing tradeoffs
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@archonsystems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@archonsystems.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase process & invoice cadence questions for Redwood engagement

Hi Dylan,

We're getting close to finalizing the SOW and procurement wanted to align on a couple of billing mechanics before we issue a PO:

- Do you require a specific PO format or header fields? We can include multiple cost centers on a single PO but need to confirm required metadata (account ID, project code, vendor tax id). I've attached our standard PO template (Archon_PO_Template_5598.pdf).
- Invoice cadence: can Redwood provide a single consolidated invoice for the month with internal BU breakdowns (line items keyed to BU codes)? Our AP prefers monthly consolidated invoices rather than multiple small invoices.
- Net terms: Archon typically requests Net 90 for platform vendors. We're proposing Net 90 for a 12-month commit in exchange for a one-time onboarding payment. Is Net 90 acceptable and if so, are there pricing concessions you can offer for that term?

Also, can you confirm the information you need from us to populate the PO (billing address, tax form, remittance instructions)?

Thanks — if it's easier we can hop on a quick call this week.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Archon Systems

Attachment: Archon_PO_Template_5598.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@archonsystems.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase process & invoice cadence questions for Redwood engagement

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PO template. Quick answers and a few asks below: 

- PO fields: we ask for PO number, billed-to company name, remit-to (we'll provide remittance details), and a line-item reference to the SOW ID (SOW-RDWD-ARCH-2026). If you include multiple BU codes we can accept them on one consolidated invoice as long as each line item includes the BU code and project code.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices with BU line-item breakdown is fine. We will produce one invoice per month and can include a CSV export attached to the invoice that contains per-line accounting codes.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30. For longer terms we typically require a concession on price. As a starting point, we can offer: Net 45 with no discount, Net 60 with a 4% discount (12-month commit), Net 90 would need additional commercial review and a larger concession. Please let me know which term you prefer and whether the 12-month commitment is formalized in the SOW.

To populate your PO we need: billing address, vendor tax ID (we will share ours), the exact legal name for invoicing, and the AP contact (name/email) who receives invoices. I attach our AR requirements checklist for your AP team.

If you'd like to discuss on a call I have slots Wed 10–11am or Fri 2–3pm PT.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_AR_requirements.pdf (text/pdf, 12KB)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Archon - Net term / discount ask (need finance signoff)

Team — Archon is asking for Net 90 in exchange for a 12-month commitment (annual). They prefer monthly consolidated invoices keyed to BU codes. I recommended Net 60 with a 4% concession; they pushed for Net 90 with larger concession.

Questions for finance/legal:
- Is offering Net 60 with a 4% discount approvable at RPS level, or should we escalate to enterprise pricing?
- Any required contract language we should add for delayed payment (late fee, interest, or payment plan)?
- For monthly consolidated invoices with BU line-iteming, are there any billing system limitations we should flag?

I cc'd Priya and Marissa for any operational caveats (SOW referencing, PO matching). This is a high-velocity opportunity — we need to move quickly if we want to hold the proposed price.

Thanks,
Dylan

[Internal: Redwood margin sensitivity — longer terms increase DSO; prefer at least partial credit or an onboarding prepay for Net >60]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Archon - Net term / discount ask (need finance signoff)

Dylan — finance notes below and approves a limited concession:

- Approve Net 60 with a 4% one-time discount if Archon signs a 12-month committed SOW and we have a valid PO on file referencing the SOW ID before the first invoice.
- Net 90 is too aggressive from a cash perspective without additional protections (e.g., partial upfront payment or a credit line/guarantee). If they insist on Net 90, escalate to Legal for a payment security addendum and to Sales Leadership for pricing tradeoffs.
- Require that invoices include: PO number, SOW ID, BU code per line, subtotal per BU, total, and bank remittance details. We will accept a monthly consolidated invoice but need the CSV breakdown for ERP import.

We should also add a clause that paperwork (signed PO + SOW) must be received within 30 days of contract signature; otherwise pricing reverts to standard list.

Vivek
CFO (cc: accounting ops)

[Attachment: none]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@archonsystems.com>
Cc: procurement@archonsystems.com, priya_natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase process & invoice cadence questions for Redwood engagement

Hi Elena — thanks for your patience while I looped in finance. Good news: we can accommodate your monthly consolidated invoice request. Here is the final commercial position Redwood can commit to now: 

- Net terms: Net 60 (payment due 60 days from invoice date) in exchange for a 12-month committed SOW.
- Discount: 4% one-time concession applied to the first 12 months' invoices (applies to recurring platform fees only; implementation fees excluded).
- Invoice format: one consolidated monthly invoice that contains per-line BU codes and project codes. Please also include a CSV export (we'll ingest into our ERP).
- Required paperwork: signed PO referencing SOW-RDWD-ARCH-2026 and the HubSpot deal ID HUB-8921. PO must be received before the first invoice.

I'll attach an updated SOW for signature and send the DocuSign envelope once you confirm acceptance of Net 60 / 4%. If you end up needing Net 90, we'll need to revisit pricing and add payment security.

Next steps: if that sounds good please send the PO with BU codes and an AP contact; we'll issue the DocuSign SOW immediately.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_Redwood-Archon_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 142KB)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@archonsystems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@archonsystems.com>, procurement@archonsystems.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase process & invoice cadence questions for Redwood engagement

Dylan — thanks, that works for us. Archon confirms: Net 60 with the 4% concession for a 12-month committed SOW. We will:

- Send a single PO (Archon_PO_5598_signed.pdf) that lists the BU codes and includes the SOW ID and HubSpot deal reference. PO will be routed to your AP team (ap@archonsystems.com).
- Expect your team to send monthly consolidated invoices with CSV line-item export.

Two small asks before we finalize:
1) Can you send a sample invoice (PDF + CSV sample) showing BU line-items so our AP can confirm it maps to our ledger?
2) Please confirm Redwood's vendor tax ID and remit-to details so we can populate our PO.

I'll attach the signed PO for your records. Once we receive the DocuSign SOW we will countersign.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get started.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Archon Systems

Attachment: Archon_PO_5598_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 102KB)
